name: Kölesd (Hungary)
description: Two equal vertical stripes of blue and yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Kölesd (a blue and green shield with a church, a wavy stripe, a bunch of grapes and a sheaf of grain) below the name KÖLESD in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
